interface.name: shoji_xwayland_position_manager_v1

description.summary: ordered position updates for an Xwayland bridge

interface.description: Private optional compositor extension. Events share the native input connection. A done event commits all preceding state/invalidate events for its epoch after the compositor has queued the corresponding output configuration. The bridge must finish checked X configuration before forwarding subsequent native input.

interface.name: shoji_xwayland_position_v1

description.summary: position of one exact native surface lifetime

interface.description: This object follows the supplied wl_surface lifetime, never its numeric id. x/y describe global logical coordinates of wl_surface local (0,0), excluding compositor decorations. geometry_x/y describe this surface window geometry origin relative to that surface, for xdg_popup parent-relative conversion. No state may be applied until the matching manager done event. An invalidated or destroyed surface cannot reuse a previous origin.
